units.source_text: 媒人觉得常陆守这一番话实在诚恳可喜，便如实转告左近少将。

en.t: The go-between thought Hitachi no Kami's words were truly sincere and pleasing, and reported them just as they were to the Sakon Lesser Captain.

units.source_text: 少将觉得有些鄙俗，然而并不讨厌，微笑着听媒人讲。

en.t: The Lesser Captain found them somewhat vulgar, but not unpleasant, and listened to the go-between with a smile.

units.source_text: 听到“使尽珍珠宝贝去求取大臣之位”的话，觉得太过分了，有些刺耳。

en.t: When he heard the phrase about using up pearls and treasures to seek a minister's rank, he felt it went too far and sounded rather jarring.

units.source_text: 他听完之后踌躇起来，说道：“那么你有没有把这情况告诉夫人？

en.t: After hearing it all, he began to hesitate and said, "Then have you told the lady about this situation?

units.source_text: 她对此事一向非常热心，如今我背了约，深恐有人讥评我反复无常、蛮不讲理，如是奈何？”

en.t: She has always been very eager about this matter, and now if I break the agreement, I greatly fear people will mock me as fickle and unreasonable. What am I to do?"
The go-between said, "What harm is there in that?

units.source_text: 现在这位小姐，也是夫人非常疼爱、悉心抚育成人的。

en.t: This young lady too was dearly loved by the lady and carefully brought up by her.

units.source_text: 只因浮舟小姐在姐妹中年龄最长，夫人担心她的婚事，因此首先将她许嫁。”

en.t: It was only because Lady Ukifune was the eldest among the sisters, and the lady was anxious about her marriage, that she arranged her betrothal first."

units.source_text: 少将也曾想到：“这浮舟向来是夫人非常关怀的爱女。

en.t: The Lesser Captain had also once thought, "This Ukifune has always been the beloved daughter whom the lady cares for deeply.

units.source_text: 今我突然变卦，毋乃不可？”

en.t: If I suddenly change my mind now, would that not be wrong?"

units.source_text: 但他又想：“让她暂时恨我无情吧，让世人讥讽我几句吧，我自己的前程幸福毕竟第一。”

en.t: But then he thought, "Let her hate me as heartless for a while, and let the world laugh at me a little. My own future and happiness come first after all."

units.source_text: 这左近少将的打算真是极度精明的。

en.t: The Sakon Lesser Captain's calculation was truly extremely shrewd.

units.source_text: 他如此变计之后，结婚日子也不调换，就在原来约定的一天晚上和浮舟的妹妹成婚了。

en.t: After changing his plan in this way, he did not even alter the wedding date, and on the very evening originally agreed upon he married Ukifune's younger sister.
